fields.name: connectHeading
fields.label: Social heading
fields.description: Above the Social Icons, e.g. CONNECT. Add the icons inside this block (Social Icons). Warning: You can add multiple social icons, but a maximum of 4 will be displayed on the live site. At most 20 characters.

fields.name: iconImage
fields.label: Icon image
fields.description: The network's logo, white on transparent (SVG or PNG). Warning: You can add multiple social icons, but a maximum of 4 will be displayed on the live site.

fields.name: iconImageAlt
fields.label: Network name
fields.description: e.g. Facebook: read out by screen readers for the link, and shown as the link in the Variant B layout. At most 30 characters.

fields.name: iconLink
fields.label: Icon link
fields.description: The JSW Motors profile on that network (full URL).
